venue.details: Universidad Centroamericana José Simeón Cañas - Cuarto piso de Centro de Recursos para el Aprendizaje y la Investigación en Universidad CRAI

items.information: **Desafío Cubo CRAI UCA 2024** se llevará a cabo en el cuarto piso de la biblioteca de la Universidad Centroamericana José Simeón Cañas, también conocida como CRAI. Esta competencia estará abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad. **El costo de inscripción no es reembolsable.** * El registro el día del evento estará sujeto a la disponibilidad de cupos y se limitará a una categoría como máximo. **Desafío Cubo CRAI UCA 2024** will be held on the fourth floor of the library at the Universidad Centroamericana José Simeón Cañas, also known as CRAI. This competition is open to competitors of any nationality. **Registration fee is non-refundable.** * On-site registration will be subject to availability and will be limited to one event maximum.

items.name: Honolulu Hippocampus 2024
items.information: ![This competition is in partnership with West Coast Cubing, LLC](https://i.imgur.com/jmSpkQE.png) ![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b5378e_88f526a00b5e4d6391ec03e6ea67452c~mv2.png/v1/fit/w_2500,h_1330,al_c/b5378e_88f526a00b5e4d6391ec03e6ea67452c~mv2.png) ### The competition weekend in O'ahu continues with an amazing side events competition! * It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need. ### This competition will be specializing in quiet events and will not have 3x3 or any traditional events. If you would like to sign up for a competition involving those events, please check out [Honolulu Hāʻulelau 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HonoluluHaulelau2024), happening on September 21st, the day before.

items.name: Oklahoma Quiet Championship 2024
items.information: This competition is recognized by CubingUSA as the Oklahoma Quiet Championship 2024. See [Oklahoma Champion Titles tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OklahomaQuietChampionship2024#46285-oklahoma-champion-titles) for more details. - Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OklahomaQuietChampionship2024#46276-competitor-information) tab before the competition. - Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition. Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OklahomaQuietChampionship2024#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule.
